reviewer: Claude (visual inspection of contact sheets: 7 views, clay/wire, 5 closeups, plus stats.json)
notes: v1 is the in-game build_kar98k2.py unchanged. Silhouette and proportions are good; length 1.115 m. Budget fails and several details are wrong.

defects.text: 19,204 triangles against a 10,000 maximum. Stock loft alone is 7,676, six full tori are 560 each, the trigger guard curve is 1,344, bevel segments on every small box.
defects.fix: Stock 56 x 20 rings, torus 20 x 6, bevel 1 segment, fewer cylinder sides, trigger guard curve resolution down. Target under 6,000.

defects.text: Front sight hood is two separate rings plus a flat top plate and two legs: reads as binoculars. The K98k hood is one tunnel round the post.
defects.fix: One hollow tube around the post on a single support.

defects.text: Rear sight is a wide flat block with a small notched plate; no readable tangent leaf, ramp or graduations. Sight radius is 0.43 m against 0.50 m (rear sight base at y = 0.275, should be near 0.20).
defects.fix: Move base to y 0.20, narrow ramp, long sloped leaf with V notch, slider, ticks.

defects.text: A black block (grip_cap) hangs under the wrist like a floating lump; the K98k has a plain semi-pistol grip with no cap.
Barrel band, nose cap and lug are bright chrome-looking steel; on a service K98k they are blued or phosphated like the barrel.
defects.fix: Use the blued material on band, nose cap, lug; keep bright steel for the bolt.

defects.text: Floor plate is a thick box proud of the stock and the trigger guard is a thin tube; they read as separate floating parts.
defects.fix: Thin flush floor plate with a wider flat guard bow.

defects.text: Bayonet lug is a block sitting on top of the nose cap, with the cleaning rod stub beside it; the lug belongs under the nose cap.
defects.fix: Lug under the nose cap (position from general knowledge, flagged in spec).

defects.text: No handguard break: the wood runs over the barrel as one smooth cylinder from receiver to nose cap.
defects.fix: Shallow step at the handguard ends.

defects.text: Blued parts show long white hair-like scratches and white chip blotches that read as paint chips; shared gun textures.
defects.fix: Deferred: needs a purpose-made blued steel texture. Flag to the user.
